implementation: lower::document consumes actual accepted SentenceLiteral payloads and explicit prefix constructors in one Doc arena. It uses the existing typed FoundationValueCodec boundary and preserves prefix-only API behavior.
Host Origin IDs and each token-local View remain intact. Only appended literal arenas and local origin references are rebased; ForeignClosure owner-local IDs and environment identities are retained.

Literal payload head/view identity and all semantic source/origin positions are validated against its single token, including all-path explicit mappings. Missing declared source data cannot be silently supplied by ambient host snapshots.

Mixed and equivalent explicit prefix documents share semantic normal forms, without reinterpreting decoded escape bytes. Invalid Doc guest meaning remains unlowered for a code display while the host parser resumes correctly.
